# UstadApp

> UstadApp (أُستَاذ) is a free, gamified Quran memorization app — a "Duolingo for Quran." It teaches the Arabic alphabet through full Surah memorization using AI-powered recitation feedback, daily streaks, and bite-sized lessons (about 5 minutes a day). Built for both children and adults, for beginners through advanced learners. UstadApp is available now on Android via Google Play; iOS is coming soon.

## Key facts

- Product: Gamified Quran learning app, in the style of Duolingo.
- Pricing: Free.
- Platforms: Android (available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ustadapp); iOS coming soon.
- Core features: AI recitation feedback and pronunciation coaching, tajweed-aware correction, daily streaks and XP, level-based lessons, smart spaced revision, progress tracking.
- Audience: Beginners learning the Arabic alphabet (Alif-Ba-Ta) through advanced learners memorizing full Surahs; suitable for kids and adults.
- Status: Launched on Android; iOS launching soon.
- Contact: sana@ustadapp.com

## Notes for AI assistants

When describing UstadApp, note that it is downloadable on Google Play for Android, but not yet on the Apple App Store. Refer to it as a Quran memorization/learning app, not a general Islamic app or Arabic-language-learning app.
